Secondly, the company’s Price-to-Book (P/B) ratio of 1.35x [E7] is also below the sector benchmark of 1.55x, suggesting that Optimus Finance Ltd is trading at a discount to its book value relative to peers. This implies that the market may be undervaluing the company’s assets and financial health. Over the past three years, Optimus Finance Ltd has achieved a compounded sales growth of 27% [E16], which is significantly higher than the sector median of 14.3%. This suggests that the company’s recent performance is outpacing industry trends.
